seriesTitle: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs

episodes.title: And the Winner Is...
episodes.summary: Flint and Sam remember when they nearly destroyed the town while competing with each other in the science fair.

episodes.title: Princess Kittymittens
episodes.summary: Flint begs Sam to let him see her most treasured possession, but when Sam relents Flint damages it and has to find a way to make it up to her.

episodes.title: Invent This!
episodes.summary: When Tim is celebrated for accidentally inventing a pencil holder, Flint gets jealous and starts to doubt his own skills as an inventor.

episodes.title: Bacon Girl
episodes.summary: Flint invents a way to make sardines taste like bacon so Sam can eat one without gagging, but Flint's invention has a few bacon-related side-effects.

episodes.title: Who You Calling Garbage?
episodes.summary: Flint creates an invention to take out the garbage, but it soon starts deciding for itself what, and who, counts as garbage.

episodes.title: The Ballad of Johnny Sardine
episodes.summary: Swallow Falls prepares to celebrate the birthday of its oldest sardine, a wish-granting fish named Johnny, but Flint and Sam put the entire event in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Millionaire Monkey
episodes.summary: When Steve wins the Swallow Falls lottery, townspeople line up claiming that they are Steve's best friend causing Flint to question Steve's true affections.

episodes.title: Baby Brent Sitter
episodes.summary: Flint and Sam baby-sit so they can buy a new board game, but when Brent hires them as his baby sitter they have to decide whether the humiliation is worth the reward.

episodes.title: Spoiler Orb
episodes.summary: Flint modifies Sam's weather-predicting orb to predict the future, but knowing their future isn't as fun as they thought it would be.

episodes.title: The Pandas Are Coming
episodes.summary: Mayor Shelbourne brings a panda to Swallow Falls, but when the town falls under the panda's spell it's up to Flint and Sam to find out what's really going on.

episodes.title: Inventors Only
episodes.summary: Flint is excited to discover there's another inventor in town, but Sam suspects the inventor has an ulterior motive for befriending Flint.

episodes.title: Clock-a-Doodle-Doo
episodes.summary: To battle his inability to wake up in the morning, Flint combines an alarm with rooster DNA to create the ultimate alarm clock.

episodes.title: The Sardemon
episodes.summary: Tim takes Flint to the wilderness to participate in the Lockwood father-son tradition of trying to catch the Sardemon.

episodes.title: Earl or Pearl?
episodes.summary: Earl goes undercover as a female student to befriend Sam and get inside information on Flint's next invention.

episodes.title: Sardinefest
episodes.summary: Sam is determined to stop Swallow Falls' annual sardine race, which she firmly believes is animal cruelty.

episodes.title: Total Samesies
episodes.summary: When they are teased for being too similar, Flint and Sam try to prove that they are totally different.

episodes.title: Monkey Me, Monkey You
episodes.summary: When Flint accidentally combines himself with Steve, he must learn to live with the monkey inside him.

episodes.title: Best Invention Ever!
episodes.summary: After hearing Flint brag about sleep-inventing the best invention ever, the Mayor sees it as a money-making opportunity.

episodes.title: That's Sal, Folks!
episodes.summary: In trying to keep Sam from moving away, Flint accidentally animates the town's sardine statue, and it begins spilling the town's secrets.

episodes.title: Cloudy with a Chance of Clouds
episodes.summary: Flint gives Sam a Cloud-Maker for the anniversary of their friendship, but Sam's new cloud friend will not leave her side.

episodes.title: The Science of the Toot
episodes.summary: In a bid to make his classmates consider his idea for a science mural, Flint creates a toot-inducing bean.

episodes.title: Mr. Stressup
episodes.summary: After being inured by one of Flint's inventions, Tim's doctor wants him to relax, and Flint has just the thing to help.

episodes.title: Virtu-earl Reality
episodes.summary: After encouraging Mr. Earl to have a day off, Sam and Flint learn he is too bored, and try to make things better for him.

episodes.title: Hair We Go Again
episodes.summary: Flint invents the hair unbalder when he realises he'll go bald one day, but Tim offers him another point of view by showing him the perks of being bald.

episodes.title: It's About Time
episodes.summary: Sam and Flint accidentally cryogenically freeze themselves in the town's time capsule, and emerge into a post-apocalyptic future.

episodes.title: Self-Helpie
episodes.summary: Flint invents a device that will put a good picture of him into the yearbook, but it also puts him in every picture that has ever existed.

episodes.title: Happy Clappy Monkey
episodes.summary: Steve falls in love with the cymbal-smashing electric monkey Flint brought in to replace Steve while he was on vacation.

episodes.title: Robot Rumble
episodes.summary: Flint enters his fearsome robot into a robot boxing competition, and when it comes face to face with Mayor Shelbourne's robot, the results are explosive.

episodes.title: My Pop Is Tops
episodes.summary: Flint and Gil argue over who has a better dad, setting off a secret competition pitting Tim and Mayor Shelbourne against each other, in a battle of parental prowess.

episodes.title: Clone Alone
episodes.summary: Flint accidentally makes a clone of himself, and is shocked to discover his clone is more popular than he is.

episodes.title: Coat of Harms
episodes.summary: Sam makes Flint a new tricked-out labcoat to replace his old smelly one, not realising it was a gift from his mom.

episodes.title: Earl of My Dreams
episodes.summary: When Flint gets Earl in trouble with his wife, Earl demands Flint help him get back into her good graces.

episodes.title: Spacy Race
episodes.summary: Flint builds a spaceship for an Australian businessman, Mr. Zorbleck, who may or may not actually be Australian.

episodes.title: Tim and Jim
episodes.summary: Tim's brother, Jim, comes to visit him.

episodes.title: Mayornormal Activity
episodes.summary: Mayor Shelbourne buys up all the town's candy at Halloween and promises to give it all to the kid who makes it through his super scary haunted house.

episodes.title: Flintenstein
episodes.summary: While attempting to debunk Hollywood pseudoscience, Flint accidentally creates his own Frankenstein-like monster.
